facts.claim: Shares of the Hyderabad Deccan Company fell by 5% after a scandal.
facts.quote: There was much excitement over the scandal about the Hj-derabad- Deccan business, and shares have gone down 5 at one blow.

facts.claim: The company was formed to take over a coal concession granted by the Nizam without payment.
facts.quote: This Company was formed to take over a con- cession which had Ijeen granted by tlie Nizam over a tract of land said to contain coal.

facts.claim: The company sold the concession for about £900,000, though its capital was £1,100,000.
facts.quote: the concessionnaires formed a Company with a capital of £1,(100,000, selling the concession for something like £900,000.
